FALLING FOR MAINE
Fall Season Special: 15% OFF Best Available Room Rate, PLUS a $100 Resort Credit.
Fall in love with Maine during the season that Travel + Leisure Magazine touts as the 'best time to visit'.
Beautiful autumn serves as our ever-welcome bridge between summer and winter, bringing bright, sunlit days adorned with our signature, vibrant New England foliage. A season made for exploring the coast, followed by cool, comfortable nights with perfect sleeping weather.
Free from the hustle and bustle of the summer crowds, this is the perfect time to visit the coast, and Cliff House Maine. Wake to morning coffee, on your private terrace, watching the sun peek over the horizon. Indulge in lazy days in the heated outdoor pool, peering over its infinity edge across the vast Atlantic. Escape into an evening of artistic musings at Ogunquit Playhouse.
Whatever your day may bring, we invite you to settle into the rhythm of our seaside escape, breathe in the crisp ocean air, and savor our world-famous New England foliage as can only be done from the coast of Maine.
Book by December 19, 2026, and enjoy 15% off our Best Available Rate, plus a $100 Resort Credit, for stays now through December 21, 2026.

About the Location
Cliff House is conveniently located in Southern Maine between Ogunquit and York, an hour’s drive north of Boston and a forty-minute drive from Portland.
The resort can easily be reached from Boston, Portland, or Manchester airports and is the perfect spot from which to enjoy the quintessential New England experience.
For real time traffic information, please view the Maine Turnpike and I-95 North Traffic Cameras.
Guests will also enjoy the scenic nearby towns of Ogunquit and York – with their beautiful beaches, shopping, and restaurants – as well as many opportunities to bike, golf, hike, and explore.
Please note: self-parking in our lots is complimentary for overnight guests (fee based valet parking is also available). In peak summer season, mandatory valet parking (and fee) may be in effect for day visitors (including spa + restaurants). Please inquire with our Concierge for more information.

Signature 2-Bedroom Oceanfront Suite
1500 ft 2 / 39 m 2
Stunning Signature 2-Bedroom Oceanfront Suites will take your stay atop Bald Head Cliff to new heights. This suite boasts a beautiful coastal Maine design throughout the two bedrooms, adjoining living room and kitchenette spaces. The primary bedroom offers one king bed and en suite bathroom, while the second offers two king beds and en suite bathroom. A living room, kitchenette, and dining area offer inviting spaces for creating meaningful experiences. Each room has direct terrace access. Guests also enjoy thoughtful, modern amenities including Comphy linens, locally made Cuddledown® comforters, three oversized flat-screen LCD televisions (living room + bedrooms), coffee and tea service, plush hooded robes with slippers, and exclusive spa luxury collection bath products by Apothia.

Our Ledges 2-Bedroom Oceanfront Suites comfortably sleep as many as eight guests. Each suite includes a primary en suite bedroom with a king-size bed, sleeper sofa, and private terrace. A second en suite bedroom features two king-size beds and an additional terrace. The spacious living room offers a full-size Tempur-Pedic® sectional sleeper sofa and direct terrace access. These suites provide an atmosphere that fosters both socialization and privacy, with oceanfront terraces accessible from each room. Marvel at the seemingly endless views, catch a stunning Maine sunrise, and maybe even spot a passing whale or two.
